rows.limitation: The bundled ffmpeg has an APE decoder but no APE encoder (`ffmpeg -encoders` lists none), so no synthetic fixture can be generated and no binary fixture is committed (R2.1 distributability rule). Detection/observation of real APE media is therefore not executed; the extension remains in the classifier vocabulary and normalization would route a real APE through the standard ffmpeg decode-to-MP3 path. Recorded explicitly instead of silently skipped.

invalidCases: corrupt audio produces media.ffprobe_failed (lib test corrupt_audio_is_an_explicit_structural_finding_and_sidecars_are_inventory) and normalization fails with a typed error (normalization_real.rs::corrupt_audio_is_rejected_by_normalization)

zero-length audio produces media.empty_file at inspection; ffprobe's raw demuxer still answers with a degenerate no-duration observation; ffmpeg refuses the encode and normalization fails with NormalizationError::Ffmpeg (normalization_real.rs::zero_length_audio_is_an_actionable_finding_and_blocks_normalization)

truncated audio probes STREAMINFO with the full declared duration but normalization fails actionably — encode error or output duration verification — and publishes nothing (normalization_real.rs::truncated_audio_fails_normalization_without_publishing)

multi-stream audio (more than one audio stream in one container) is observed with its true stream count and rejected with a typed Verification error (normalization_real.rs::multi_stream_audio_is_observed_and_rejected_actionably)

oversized embedded artwork beyond the observation bound is skipped with artwork.embedded_oversized while audio observation and normalization continue (normalization_real.rs::oversized_embedded_artwork_is_bounded_and_recorded)

an audio-vocabulary extension whose probed content carries no audio stream (video-only container) is recorded unsupported_or_corrupt_audio with media.ffprobe_failed and rejected by normalization (normalization_real.rs::video_only_container_is_recorded_unsupported_and_rejected)

extension/content mismatch (WAV content in .mp3 name) is detected from probed streams, mime overridden from the probed container, media.extension_mismatch finding recorded, and output converted to MP3 despite the extension (normalization_real.rs::wav_content_in_mp3_named_files_is_detected_from_content_and_converted)

missing duration cannot be synthesized deterministically for an on-disk file with the bundled ffprobe; the failure mode is pinned by normalize.rs unit test missing_source_duration_is_a_typed_verification_failure (NormalizationError::MissingField("source duration"))
malformed artwork produces artwork.invalid or artwork.oversized
